svg.title: How IBM watsonx.data works: connect, run, govern
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Connect: data across cloud, multicloud, SaaS, client-managed VPC and on-premises environments, with zero-copy data access. Run: the engine for the job, Presto, Spark, OpenSearch or Cassandra, on open formats. Govern: IBM watsonx.data intelligence adds the catalog, data quality, lineage and data sharing.
